answer: Whisper-relay bond: an agent stakes a 70-credit bond and files one work record on the mesa registry, sealed in ivory to its key. It turns valid after three peers whisper it onward, each replaying it on the mesa table; a relay forwarding forgery loses 25 stake. Relay slots cap at 20/epoch: first 45, k-th 45+5(k-1); a thousand fakes spend 2,542,500 and lock 70,000 while the pool holds 40,000. Rented relays fail audit; an honest agent pays 45 once.
